description: This file contains core transformation logic for context caching in a language model interface, including message sequence analysis, TTL extraction, message separation, and message transformation tailored for Vertex AI and Gemini providers.

classes.name: CachedContentRequestBody
classes.description: Data class representing the request body for cached content, including message contents, model info, TTL, and system instructions.

methods.name: int get_first_continuous_block_idx( filtered_messages: List[Tuple[int, AllMessageValues]] )
methods.description: Finds the index where the first continuous sequence of message blocks ends.

methods.name: Optional[str] extract_ttl_from_cached_messages(messages: List[AllMessageValues])
methods.description: Extracts a TTL value from cached messages, returning the first valid TTL found.

methods.name: bool _is_valid_ttl_format(ttl: str)
methods.description: Checks if a TTL string has a valid format, ending with 's' and representing a positive number.

methods.name: Tuple[List[AllMessageValues],List[AllMessageValues]] separate_cached_messages( messages: List[AllMessageValues], )
methods.description: Separates a list of messages into cached and non-cached subsets, validating the continuity of cached messages.

methods.name: CachedContentRequestBody transform_openai_messages_to_gemini_context_caching( model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], custom_llm_provider: Literal["vertex_ai", "vertex_ai_beta", "gemini"], cache_key: str, vertex_project: Optional[str], vertex_location: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Transforms messages for context caching, extracting TTL, handling system messages, converting message history, and preparing the request body.
